_comment: Locked scGT-Link v2 recipe for the 44 BEELINE tasks (manuscript Table S4 / Fig. 2–5).

scgpt_checkpoint.name: scGPT human (cellxgene census)
scgpt_checkpoint.note: best_model.pt is not shipped in git (large); args.json and vocab.json are tracked under scGPT_human/.

gene_mapping.default: exact then case-insensitive symbol match into the human scGPT vocabulary; missing genes use the pad embedding

common_ablation_flags.wo_scgpt_lappe_only: disable scGPT features / LapPE-only encoder path
